tools.name: seo_audit_summary

tools.name: compare_visibility

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_visibility_score, seo_audit_summary, generate_llms_txt, generate_seo_fixes, get_product_analytics, get_listing_badge, list_product, generate_review, list_my_reviews · Private data: generate_llms_txt, generate_seo_fixes, list_tracked_sites, get_product_analytics, check_submission_readiness, generate_submission_kit, get_listing_badge, track_product, list_product, record_submission, generate_review, list_my_reviews · Public sink: list_directory_listings, generate_submission_kit, record_submission · Destructive: seo_audit_summary, generate_seo_fixes, track_product, list_product.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_visibility_score, seo_audit_summary, generate_llms_txt, generate_seo_fixes, get_product_analytics, get_listing_badge, list_product, generate_review, list_my_reviews · Private data: generate_llms_txt, generate_seo_fixes, list_tracked_sites, get_product_analytics, check_submission_readiness, generate_submission_kit, get_listing_badge, track_product, list_product, record_submission, generate_review, list_my_reviews · Public sink: list_directory_listings, generate_submission_kit, record_submission · Destructive: seo_audit_summary, generate_seo_fixes, track_product, list_product

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
